xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3847: Substrate Phase 2: verdict and anchor are one write; gates are honest and immutable

plan.title: Substrate Phase 2: verdict and anchor are one write; gates are honest and immutable
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5-1

narratives.Problem: A terminal review verdict can land without an evidence anchor, so the drift patrol later resets a passed review to pending and re-dispatches with force:true. Equal anchors auto-pass the test role (191 of 290 corpus test verdicts are that skip), the review-passed CLI silently writes verificationStatus passed, verification overwrites its single artifact each run, CI can skip vitest on an overdeck/test stamp, the lint ratchet misattributes findings, branches are cut from a local main that drifts, re-review accepts dirty trees, and the verification cycle counter resets on every request.
narratives.Proposal: Make the verdict door refuse anchorless verdicts and write blocked verdicts with their anchor in one write; mark drifted passed reviews stale instead of resetting; delete the anchor-equality test skip and the review-command verification override; keep immutable per-run verification artifacts; add a test-skip gate and allowOnly:false; run vitest on every CI push and bind the stamp to the tested sha; ratchet by per-file counts; fetch and branch from origin/<target>; refuse re-review on dirty or unchanged HEAD; make the cycle counter per issue; audit, then delete patrols #35 and #41; document.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to the branch-protection context name overdeck/test (epic Decision 7).
- No new review roles or changes to reviewer prompts.
- No rewrite of the verification runner beyond the named insertion points.
- No deletion of patrols outside #35 and #41.

narrative.Action: Follow PRD W9 in drafts/pan-3847.md. In review-verdict-writer.ts:146-153 replace the no-evidence landing: refuse when input.evidenceHead is missing (return landed:false, reason no-evidence-head, emit a warn activity entry); when the row has no lastVerifiedCommit, land verdict plus reviewedAtCommit together with classification no-verification-anchor; treat the !status branch (131-138) the same way and extend the VerdictOutcome types. In specialists/done.ts:140-164 snapshot the workspace head for passed and blocked, exit 1 when no head is available, and delete the second blocked write at done.ts:333-356. Checkpoint: every other recordReviewVerdict caller (deacon-review-status.ts:579, deacon.ts:1553, deacon-review-signals.ts:213, deacon-review-unsignaled.ts, verdict-restore.ts) must pass an anchor or log and skip; never fabricate one.

metadata.parallelSafeReason: Every later item that shares review-status.ts, done.ts or review-pipeline.ts with this one is behind a blocks edge, so its writes land first.

Immutable per-run verification artifacts

narrative.Action: Follow PRD W13 in drafts/pan-3847.md. In verification-artifact.ts add verificationRunArtifactPath(workspacePath, ranAt, head8) under .overdeck/verification and make writeVerificationArtifact write the per-run file, copy it to verification-latest.json, and return the per-run path. In verification-runner.ts capture ranAt at run start and head8 via execAsync git rev-parse --short=8 HEAD, pass them at 661-670, set fullOutputPath to the per-run path so the feedback at line 688 names the immutable file; keep running-progress writes on verification-latest.json only. Checkpoint: add a 30-day prune of per-run files to cleanupStaleAgentState, or to reconcileIdleWorkspaceStacks if the former does not enumerate workspaces; grep readVerificationArtifact( under src/dashboard to keep the Lint node reader working.

items.title: Given two consecutive writeVerificationArtifact calls in a temp workspace, when they finish, then .overdeck/verification contains two files and verification-latest.json equals the second.
Given a failed gate, when the per-run file is read, then it contains the gate output and the feedback string names a path under .overdeck/verification.
Given per-run files older than 30 days, when the retention patrol runs, then it deletes them and preserves newer files.
Test-skip gate before the quality gates; allowOnly false

In verification-runner.ts call runTestSkipGate before the quality gates and, on violations, prepend a failed required QualityGateResult named test-skip so the existing failed-gate handling, artifact, feedback and cycle count apply. Add allowOnly: false to vitest.config.ts and the frontend vitest config.

items.title: Given a diff that adds it.skip( in a.test.ts, when findTestSkipViolations runs, then it returns one skip violation.

Re-review refuses a dirty tree or an unchanged approved HEAD

In review-pipeline.ts, before the status reset in both the request handler (line 468 onward) and the trigger path (before setPendingOperation at 257), return 409 with a hint when git status --porcelain is non-empty, and 409 HEAD already approved when the snapshot head equals a passed reviewedAtCommit with no reviewStaleSince.
